title: 第288章 我买了第287章 买车
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
第288章我买了
就在这时，之前那个假装接电话的老销售晃悠过来了。
他叫王建，四十来岁，肚子微凸，领带系得松松垮垮，一看就是店里的老油条。
他手里端着杯咖啡，靠在展台边上，嘴角带着似笑非笑的弧度。
“喂喂喂，小周啊，你这是带客人看什么呢？这车三百多万呢，你让人这么随便坐，摸坏了算谁的？”
王建板着脸说道，这言语之间，侮辱人的意味十足。
周琳的脸一下子红了：“王哥，客人想体验一下。”
“体验什么体验？”
王建嗤笑一声，上下打量了一眼李大炮身上的衣服和裤腿上的泥点子，又瞥了一眼窗外那辆破三轮，拖长了尾音。
“有些客人啊，来咱们店里就是拍个照发朋友圈装个逼，回头在网上就成咱们的准车主了，回头把我这车给摸出划痕来，你赔啊？”
他说着还伸手在车门上假装擦了擦：“别摸了别摸了，下来下来。”
赵沐晨气得脸都鼓起来了，刚要说话，李大炮却从车里下来了。
他走到王建面前，个头比对方高了半个头，目光平淡地看他：“你在叫什么？”
王建被他看得有点发毛，但嘴上还不饶人：“我叫什么不重要，重要的是……”
“不重要就闭嘴。”
李大炮一句话把他噎了回去，转头看向站在一旁手足无措、眼眶都有点发红的周琳：“这车，我买了，全款。”
展厅里瞬间安静。
王建的咖啡杯停在半空，嘴张着，像是被谁按了暂停键。
另外几个在旁边的销售也都扭头看了过来，眼神里写满了不可置信。
虽然他们这里是市区，但有钱人也不多，这种售价高达300多万的豪车，从来都没有卖出去过。

“先生您，您说真的？"周琳的声音都在抖。
李大炮从口袋里掏出一张银行卡，说道：“当然是真的，手续你帮我办，保险、上牌、临牌，一起弄利索。”
他也不是要买这么一辆车装逼，而是真的一眼看中了，虽然说价格有些贵，但还在他能接受的范围之内
周琳整个人像被雷劈了一样杵在原地，过了好几秒才猛地反应过来，拼命点头：“好！好！我这就去！先生您这边请，请您喝杯咖啡，我马上给您办手续。”
“哎哎哎！”
王建终于回过神了，一个箭步窜过来，喝道：“小周你一个实习生懂什么流程？这种大客户得我来接待！先生先生，您听我说，这车我可以给您争取更多的优惠。”
他一边说一边往李大炮身边凑，脸上的笑容堆得比花还灿烂，跟刚才那副嘴脸判若两人。
“优惠？”
李大炮扭头看了他一眼，笑道：“你刚才不是说让我别摸吗？我怕把车摸坏了。”
王建脸上的笑僵住了，嘴角抽了抽：“那个，那是误会，我开玩笑的。"
“你开你的玩笑，我买我的车。”
李大炮不再看他，对周琳招了招手：“走，带我去办手续。”
周琳激动得手都在哆嗦，捧着银行卡像捧着圣旨一样，生怕被王建抢了去。
她领着李大炮和赵沐晨往办公区走，脚步轻快得快要飘起来。

content_en:
Chapter 288 I bought it
Just then, the old salesman who pretended to answer the phone wandered over.
His name is Wang Jian, he is in his forties, with a slightly protruding belly and a loose tie. He looks like a veteran in the store.
He was holding a cup of coffee in his hand, leaning against the edge of the booth, with a half-smile at the corner of his mouth.
"Hey, hey, hey, Xiao Zhou, what are you showing the guests to? This car costs more than three million. If you let people sit in it casually, who's responsible if it gets damaged?"
Wang Jian said with a straight face, his words were full of insult.
Zhou Lin's face suddenly turned red: "Brother Wang, the guest wants to experience it."
“What’s the experience like?”
Wang Jian sneered, looked up and down at Li Dapao's clothes and the mud spots on his trouser legs, then glanced at the broken three-wheeler outside the window, and drew out his voice.
"Some customers come to our store just to take photos and post them on WeChat to show off, and then they become our prospective car owners online. If they scratch my car later, will you pay for it?"
As he spoke, he stretched out his hand and pretended to wipe it on the car door: "Don't touch it, don't touch it, come down."
Zhao Muchen was so angry that his face bulged. Just as he was about to speak, Li Dapao got out of the car.
He walked up to Wang Jian, who was half a head taller than him, and looked at him flatly: "What are you calling?"
Wang Jian was a little embarrassed by him, but he still said: "It doesn't matter what my name is, the important thing is..."
"Shut up if it's not important."
Li Dapao choked him back with one sentence, and turned to look at Zhou Lin, who was standing by at a loss with her eyes a little red: "I bought this car, full payment."
The exhibition hall fell silent for a moment.
Wang Jian's coffee cup stopped in mid-air, his mouth open, as if someone had pressed the pause button.
Several other salesmen nearby also turned their heads and looked over, their eyes full of disbelief.
Although they are in an urban area, there are not many rich people. This kind of luxury car with a price of more than 3 million has never been sold.
"Sir, are you serious?" Zhou Lin's voice was trembling.
Li Dapao took out a bank card from his pocket and said, "Of course it's true. You can help me with the procedures, including insurance, registration, and temporary registration. Let's do it together."
He didn't want to buy such a car to show off, but he really liked it at first sight. Although the price was a bit expensive, it was still within the range he could accept.
Zhou Lin's whole body was stuck in place as if struck by lightning. It took a few seconds to react suddenly and nodded desperately: "Okay! Okay! I'll go right away! Sir, please come here and buy you a cup of coffee. I will handle the formalities for you right away."
"Hey hey hey!"
Wang Jian finally came to his senses, rushed over, and shouted: "Xiao Zhou, what process do you, an intern, know? I have to handle such a big customer! Sir, listen to me, I can get you more discounts on this car."
As he spoke, he moved closer to Li Dapao. The smile on his face was brighter than a flower, and he looked completely different from the one just now.
"Discount?"
Li Dapao turned to look at him and said with a smile: "Didn't you just tell me not to touch it? I'm afraid I might damage the car."
The smile on Wang Jian's face froze, and the corners of his mouth twitched: "Well, that was a misunderstanding, I was joking."
"You're kidding me, I'll buy my car."
Li Dapao stopped looking at him and waved to Zhou Lin: "Let's go, take me to go through the formalities."
Zhou Lin was so excited that her hands were trembling, holding the bank card as if holding an imperial edict, for fear of being snatched away by Wang Jian.
She led Li Dapao and Zhao Muchen towards the office area, her steps so brisk that they almost floated.
